projects.title: MCP Onboarding & Gateway UX
projects.shortDescription: End-to-end MCP onboarding from Figma designs through gateway-integrated configuration flows.
projects.description: Designed and implemented MCP onboarding experiences including responsive UI, OpenAPI-guided validation, SAFE-related integrations, and gateway-side configuration—streamlining how teams adopt and configure MCP integrations.
projects.problem: Complex MCP setup created friction for integrators and required consistent guidance across UI and gateway layers.
projects.solution: Translated Figma designs into production UI with structured validation, error handling, and gateway-aligned API integrations.
projects.impact: Reduced onboarding ambiguity and improved consistency across integration workflows.

projects.title: Finance Transformation Platform
projects.shortDescription: Enterprise Angular application with measurable UI performance improvements.
projects.description: Developed and optimized a finance transformation suite with attention to rendering efficiency, reusable components, and REST-driven workflows for financial operations teams.
projects.problem: Heavy enterprise UI struggled with rendering efficiency as data volume grew.
projects.solution: Angular performance optimizations, efficient data binding patterns, and component reuse.
projects.impact: Approximately 30% improvement in frontend UI performance and rendering efficiency.

projects.title: Bank Reconciliation Workflows
projects.shortDescription: Operational UI for reconciliation with integrated financial APIs.
projects.description: Built reconciliation workflows connecting REST APIs to support data processing, reconciliation operations, and efficient analyst/user flows.
projects.problem: Manual reconciliation processes needed structured, reliable digital workflows.
projects.solution: Workflow-centric Angular UI with API-backed reconciliation states and validation.
projects.impact: Streamlined reconciliation operations and improved data-processing efficiency.

projects.title: TalentPool Module
projects.shortDescription: End-to-end talent onboarding and availability management.
projects.description: Delivered TalentPool across frontend and backend: employee/SME onboarding, client engagement tracking, and assignment, leave, and availability management.
projects.problem: Talent operations needed a single system for profiles, assignments, and availability.
projects.solution: Unified module spanning onboarding, engagement, and stateful assignment tracking.
projects.impact: Improved visibility into talent availability and client engagement.

projects.title: SpendChecks Mobile
projects.shortDescription: Ionic expense app with approval workflows for iOS and Android.
projects.description: SpendChecks enables users to add, approve, and reject expenses with real-time status tracking, secure data handling, and reusable UI patterns.
projects.problem: Field teams needed mobile-first expense capture and approvals.
projects.solution: Cross-platform Ionic application with approval states and API-backed persistence.
projects.impact: Faster expense processing with clear approval visibility.

projects.title: Remittance, Prepaid & eKYC Suite
projects.shortDescription: Modular Angular SPA for financial product lines.
projects.description: Scalable Angular SPA with responsive UI supporting international remittance, prepaid card, and eKYC service flows with REST integrations.
projects.problem: Multiple financial products required a unified yet modular customer experience.
projects.solution: Modular SPA architecture with reusable components and API-driven screens.
projects.impact: Maintainable multi-product frontend with consistent UX patterns.

projects.title: Cashup Agent Portal
projects.description: Led development of the Cashup Agent Portal with automated commission calculations integrated into agent workflows.
projects.problem: Manual commission calculations introduced errors and slowed agents.
projects.solution: Automated calculation engine within agent-facing portal workflows.
projects.impact: Approximately 20% reduction in commission calculation errors.

projects.title: NFC Payment Web Portal
projects.shortDescription: Web-based NFC payments without a dedicated mobile app.
projects.description: Web portal enabling Shukur users to complete NFC payment transactions through the browser experience.
projects.problem: Users needed NFC payments without installing another mobile application.
projects.solution: Web-based payment portal with REST integrations and responsive UX.
projects.impact: Expanded payment access through browser-based flows.
